content:
I need you to fetch the Wikipedia page for Richard Hatch (Survivor winner) and find his birth date. Use python3 with urllib to fetch https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Richard_Hatch

Print the exact birth date found on the page. Also try to find if it says anything about being born in May.

If python3 doesn't work, try curl or wget to fetch the page and grep for "born" or "Born".
I'll fetch the Wikipedia page using multiple methods in parallel to find Richard Hatch's birth date

arguments.command:
python3 -c "
import urllib.request
import re
url = 'https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Richard_Hatch'
req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0'})
html = urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=15).read().decode('utf-8')
# Look for birth date patterns
# Wikipedia infobox typically has 'born' with date
matches = re.findall(r'born[^<]{0,100}', html, re.IGNORECASE)
for m in matches[:10]:
    print('MATCH:', m.strip()[:120])
print('---')
# Also look for 'May' near birth
may_matches = re.findall(r'(?:born|Born).{0,50}May.{0,50}', html)
for m in may_matches[:5]:
    print('MAY MATCH:', m.strip()[:120])
"
